patch.value: Bound coverage aggregation memory and compare default-heap CI behavior

During the PR #122 privacy-scope regression work, an identity-isolated npm release:check completed 587/587 tests with zero failures, skips or cancellations, then c8 report aggregation exhausted Node's default 4 GiB heap. Native coverage receipts occupied approximately 2.9 GiB. The security fix is being validated with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 and unchanged source inventory and four 100-percent thresholds. Compare default-heap CI behavior, investigate bounded report aggregation or documented resource requirements, and retain complete authored-source and real CLI coverage. Earlier local heap-exhaustion observations also appear in pm-github-fmrf; this task tracks current default-heap acceptance separately from the scope fix in pm-github-wrmt.

value.text: Confirmed resource workaround: complete identity-isolated npm and Bun release:check each passed 587/587 tests and all 11 checks with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288. Coverage remains exact 100/100/100/100 across 12 authored modules, without source exemptions or threshold changes. The earlier default-heap npm run passed all 587 tests before c8 aggregation exhausted the heap. Default-heap CI comparison and bounded aggregation remain follow-up work; the security change does not alter coverage implementation or CI memory settings.

Adjust only the c8 merge heap ceiling to 12288 MiB, leaving headroom on this public repository's documented 16 GB ubuntu-latest runners (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners#standard-github-hosted-runners-for-public-repositories). All four coverage thresholds remain 100, the complete 19-module inventory, zero-exclusion policy, test set and dependency pins stay unchanged. General bounded aggregation remains unfinished and this item will not be closed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Native incremental replay of the same 3839 receipts finished without heap exhaustion: peak RSS 1632684 KiB (1.557 GiB), versus 12798016 KiB (12.205 GiB) before. The replay reports 13197/13197 lines and statements, 422/422 functions, and 5077/5078 branches; the sole uncovered privacy CLI branch corresponds to the baseline's two shared-store privacy failures. No passing full gate is claimed from this replay. Selected native --merge-async, retaining all remapping/inclusion behavior and every raw receipt; custom pre-filtering is unnecessary. The heap flag is now 3072 MiB, about 1.44 GiB above the measured peak RSS (a conservative upper bound for heap). Extending the existing real-c8 test with 512 synthetic excluded receipts under a 128 MiB merge heap, plus covered/uncovered-line and unloaded-module checks; no test files or source modules are added or excluded.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Regression verification passed 10/10 coverage-gate tests directly and through pm test --run --progress. The 512-receipt fixture serializes 158244352 bytes and passes with a 128 MiB merge heap. Removing only --merge-async reproduced a small-heap OOM and failed the many-receipt assertion. A separate c8 normalization mutation dropped source.ts only when its receipt contained a zero-count range; it failed the retained-covered-counter assertion. Both mutations were restored, then the linked test passed. Source inventory remains 28 modules and the full suite still contains 1609 tests. Measurement, margin, native-filter safety and reproduction commands are documented in docs/bounded-coverage-merge.md.

Final receipts: 3844 files / 10084268775 bytes. All source/test hashes were unchanged before/after validation. Typecheck, build, 261 documented declarations, lint, zero duplication, 3718-object privacy audit, zero production vulnerabilities, 75-file pack dry run, changelog check and publish attestation all passed.
